job: Preserve the uncommitted state from the corrupt Cruush checkout in a separate good-side worktree for later review and merge.
allowed_files: all untracked paths listed by git ls-files --others --exclude-standard in /Volumes/corrupt/Cruushv2-1
preserved_behavior: No commit, merge, push, deployment, or source deletion is performed.
The target worktree is based on the good checkout HEAD before transfer.
non_goals: No PostHog SDK removal or replacement.
No dependency installation or test execution during transfer.
No resolution of semantic conflicts between the two dirty checkouts.
required_proof: Verify source HEAD, target HEAD, tracked diff inventory, untracked inventory, and target status.
Report any patch conflicts or files that could not be transferred.
